Ordered a dash cam, it came but it was not like the picture, the mount was tiny and the power cord sticks up past the mount. It's unusable. Now whether it is TEMU and/or the seller, they denied a full refund. I tried the return feature as they claim every order gets free returns. 
That also isn't there, it says I have to pay for shipping it back, and "you CAN get refunded for shipping" not you will.

They allow the "sellers" to discontinue the item, this item was sometime between the order date of 9th to arrival date of 15th of July, so no reviews can be read for this listing. Then the seller just relists the exact same item/s again with no reviews using the same pictures. I took a video of this, as you can see what other items the same "seller" lists.

Be careful what you spend there and the  "Star" seller reviews. This seller is supposedly #8 on the "Star" list and they will do nothing about anything, like the false advertisement they put up and the fact I cantt use this. 

Also I suspect the item had been a return, as the main screen had no protective film on it and looks scratched.

After some further digging the "seller" is listing different cameras using the same 5 lens picture and I see one of their ads for a lower lens camera that has the same mount I got.

More info 7-18-26, I had made an order for a phone case in June 6-14-26 that I had to send back, I was sent a case that wasn't for my phone model. 

I made 2 new orders a month later 7-9-26 the same day, another phone case and the dash cam. They did not come together. For some reason when I try to use the return this item, it only pops up with one option. That I need to pay to send it back..
"Send by yourself You can be reimbursed
Use a prepaid return method to send back your items. After sending them back, add the package's tracking information."

The request I made for  full refund was denied by the seller. It was about the time I tried to make a negative review on it, and saw it was discontinued "This item details are unavailable. Your review of this item can still be found in Your profile". Meaning no one else will see my review. It's not on their store profile either that I can see.

I did another return request but the same single option comes up. So, I canceled the request again.

The seller is "B Car Electron". If you look at them, they have other dash cam items using the exact same picture this did, as the picture on my order shows. If you go to the see more link a few times, there are different pictures of this camera that shows the type of mount I got. So it is not discontinued under the other pictures.

If you could just send me a different mount that would be ok..

7-18-26, I get an email saying they have read this review and ask for more information, that needs to be done in 3 days, which I've added and the order number, plus this lame cookie cutter reply to this post. They have the order number and my name. Further assistance??? I've had no assistance, I'm not going back to the robot chat again and explain it all again and again so Temu can end up pushing store credit. It's not that difficult to see in the mounting picture I attached to their site review and the robots chat of what was sent vs what was shown on the picture. They really need email instead of their dumb virtual robot chat too. I'm done wasting my time.....I'm sticking to my 1 rating, I would do 0 if it were an option...

data.review_body:
Reading the small print it appears to say that €3 is added to every item for customs duty.

Therefore a small low value item can escalate by 300-400% in price.

Given they know what they will add it is very evasive to still show the pre duty cost not the final cost and only add a lump figure at checkout which with my multi items was around double expectation.

I have no idea of each items full cost and probably would have deleted all low value items after the reality check.

Fortunately my gym shirts, shorts and gloves were a good saving so it’s not the overall value that worries me.  The misrepresentation does.

I have paid customs on many cross border items and there is no way the total import duty for one small bag valued at about €109 should be €44 without an actual customs validation receipt.

BEWARE INFLATED CUSTOMS CHARGES

EDIT:

You have requested specific details of my purchase in relation to a generic statement.

All you need to justify is the €3 charge on for instance 5 items I bought between €0.66 and €0.96 which appear to have gone from about €4 total to €19.

“Import charges:     43,56€

For orders shipped from outside the EU with a value of €150 or less, Temu will charge import charges of €3 per different item in the order, plus applicable VAT. For this purpose, the same items will be counted only once.”

How does the import duty on a €0.66 item get charged at €3 and where is the proof that Spanish Customs made that charge.

Vague non specific information which in my opinion from paying no more than €7 on any other item I have received across Spains EU border makes it seem like profit inflation not a genuine fee. 

Please provide proof customs charge a minimum per item fee of €3 or the truth will be obvious.

EDIT AND RESPONSE

It is clear that you do not want to answer my question for everyone to read.  That tells everyone all they need to know about the mythical Customs duty of in my case up to 5x the item value.

Sellers of small value items will see sales evaporate once customers notice this obvious back door inflation so well done damaging their small income as I am sure they won’t be getting the money.

Given Customs fees are paid by the recipient receiving the parcel once Spanish Customs assess the individual parcel it is also illogical to put a guessed fee on each item.

I will not be speculating with any small cost items as whilst I was happy to bin the “junk” I am not willing to pay a premium now to do so.

data.review_body:
Temu is scamming EU consumers. I have been trying to return a faulty item for over a month, but instead of providing a reasonable return option, they issued a shipping label for a carrier that does not operate in my area. They are effectively forcing me to travel 99 km each way just to return a defective product.

Customer support has been extremely frustrating. Agents take 5–10 minutes to respond, then immediately ask if I’m still there. If I do not reply instantly, they close the chat and disconnect the conversation. I have spent an average of two hours per day dealing with support, with no resolution.

When I requested copies of my chat transcripts to provide to my bank as evidence of the dispute, I was told that Temu does not provide chat transcripts. This makes it very difficult for customers to document their interactions and seek assistance through their payment provider.

My experience has been that Temu’s return process is unnecessarily difficult, customer service is ineffective, and consumer rights are not being respected. I would strongly advise EU consumers to be cautious before purchasing from this platform.
